facts.title: Plasma — Stunning WebGL Backgrounds Made Easy
facts.description: Tune colors, speed, and warp intensity live. Copy the generated WebGL shader and drop it into your project.

research.name: Plasma
research.note: In-browser WebGL background generator with live color, speed and warp controls that exports HTML, JS, JSON or iframe.

effects: Animated warped plasma gradient background with grain and dither
